column1: # Sonar rules that a StyleBro or SDK rule fixes (docs/migrating.md, "Coming from SonarQube"). Tab-separated:
# Sonar id, the rule that fixes it, mode (on: the rule is turned on; option: only the setting, the rule must be on already),
# a setting written with it (or -), a note for the report (or -). Mode none: not covered, the note says why (rule -).
# Then per Sonar version (SonarAnalyzer.CSharp): the first one with the rule (or -: 9.16 or older) and the first one
# with it in "Sonar way" when that changed (or -), from the rule metadata in github.com/SonarSource/sonar-dotnet
# (analyzers/rspec/cs at the release tags). Older versions don't have the rule, or don't turn it on by default.

column5: BRO1309 also checks methods, properties, events and enum members (Sonar's S100)
public classes stay Sonar's (making them static changes the API)
public members stay Sonar's (making them static changes the API)
CA1852's fix also seals private nested classes with protected members (CS0628 warnings: 144 in SmartEnum)
only overloads with the same access stay together, as Sonar's S4136 asks; between accesses StyleCop's SA1202 order stays
